free_tier.stated: Standard plan: USD 7 per TB per month of storage and USD 7 per TB of egress, with a USD 5 minimum monthly fee. No free tier: the free trial is USD 0, free for 30 days, with no credit card required and 25GB free storage for 30 days.
free_tier.notes: no standing free allowance; the trial's 25GB of upload and download for 30 days is the only free volume

per_object_cap.stated: no maximum: the S3-compatible gateway sets no limit on object size and none per PUT operation; a multipart upload takes up to 10000 parts of at least 5 MiB each, the last part excepted
per_object_cap.notes: objects under 50 KB are billed as 50 KB on the Standard plan; that is a billing floor, not a size cap

retention.stated: no expiry of stored objects is stated; objects deleted before 30 days are billed for the rest of the 30 days, and accounts with a USD 0 balance at the end of a billing cycle and no active storage are suspended and then deleted
retention.notes: the 30-day minimum storage duration is billed, not an expiry; Object Mount users are exempt from it

egress.terms: Metered at $7/TB — verbatim "Egress $7/TB" on both Standard and Advanced. No free allowance, no ratio.

tooling: S3 SDKs, rclone, Uplink CLI, Object Mount
chaining: Egress must be fronted by Cloudflare or the $7/TB dominates everything.

limits.value: Pro account: 25 TB storage per project and 100 TB egress bandwidth per project, 3 projects; increases on request
Pro account: 100 requests per second per project, and 1 write per second to the same object name
free trial: upload and download 25GB free for 30 days

limits_note: Standard objects under 50 KB are billed as 50 KB, and objects deleted before 30 days are billed for the rest of the 30 days. The Advanced plan stores in U.S. SOC2 type 2 data centers at USD 10 per TB per month with the same USD 7 per TB egress. Accounts paying with USDC are exempt from the USD 5 monthly minimum.

identity_cost.detail: sign-up asks for an email address and a password, with no card; Pro account limits follow a payment method: a credit card (some debit cards; prepaid cards are not supported), Google Pay, Apple Pay, a bank account, or a deposit of USD 10 or more in USDC on Ethereum mainnet

reliability_note: designed for 11 nines (99.999999999%) durability via erasure coding; accounts with a USD 0 balance at the end of a billing cycle and no active storage are suspended and then deleted
